service_fit.missingSemantics: unscored (null), excluded from composite, counted against coverage — never imputed
service_fit.rubric: Profile match plus share of the service's signal families covered by usable evidence; disqualifying anti-signal match zeroes the dimension with a flag.

inputs: usable need-family evidence with grades and independence groups
need_strength.missingSemantics: unscored (null), excluded from composite, counted against coverage — never imputed
need_strength.rubric: Breadth across independent groups, supporting count and grade average; single-source cases score lower by construction.

timing.missingSemantics: unscored (null), excluded from composite, counted against coverage — never imputed
timing.rubric: Strongest decayed recency signal per family rules; undated evidence is neutral, never fresh.

inputs: usable evidence grades, independence groups, review flags
evidence_confidence.missingSemantics: unscored (null), excluded from composite, counted against coverage — never imputed
evidence_confidence.rubric: Grade average with independence bonus and needs-review penalty; grade-C sources labelled wherever they contribute.

actionability.missingSemantics: unscored (null) only when no channel information exists at all; otherwise scored from available facts, gaps listed
actionability.evidence: domain fact; operator answers recorded verbatim
actionability.rubric: Reachability from established facts plus operator-confirmed answers; unknown answers are missing, never assumed.

pursuit_priority.rubric: Composite adjusted by capacity alignment ONLY (focus matches). Intrinsic dimensions are never touched by capacity.
